title: Grid: playtest titles and cosmetics on name tags
body:
No automatic tag: a key gets PLAYTESTER only from its first counted contribution award, never from joining the program. Read NIP-32 titles signed by the playtest referee through the mobile XP reader from #9847 phase 1, and draw: PLAYTESTER under the name tag, a ground ring for founding-playtester, marks for bug-hunter and fix-verifier, and a brief ball glow for raider. Opted-in keys only (published trainer profile); shapes, not colors. Depends on #9847.
Spec: `docs/game/playtesting.md`, section Titles and cosmetics.
